additionalVarieties.name: Green Vienna
additionalVarieties.text: An early variety with green skin and white flesh. Sow in spring or summer.

additionalVarieties.name: Lanro
additionalVarieties.text: An open-pollinated variety with pale green globes and white flesh. Pick them young while they are tender.

additionalVarieties.name: Purple Vienna
additionalVarieties.text: A useful choice for a late crop. Pick the purple-skinned globes while they are still young and tender.
